findings: Both T1 roots receive dedicated scene imagery only under father_passed. Cafe preserves two y3 adult identities, coats, black crewneck, deliberate downcast gaze, hands, cup/envelope/paper/A5 scale; solitary desk does not invent another home layout or an additional person.

The original cafe identity/style was acceptable but its important objects were actually hidden by the prose panel. That product framing verdict was REWORK. A first reframe was still too low; the final reframe resolves the action/envelope occlusion across all forty inspected surfaces.

At compact resolution the lower notebook and lower hands may remain under the normal panel, but the notebook silhouette, empty envelope, instruction sheet and meaningful hand position remain identifiable. Paper handling is armed silently at the actual source clause, dispatched once at -8 dB only when that clause is revealed, and excluded from replay/result/choices. Existing source-position fields preserve the read side without a new save field or permanent flag.

The same frozen known selector owns prose, CG and conditional direction. Living-Father/Jiyeon paths retain their original surfaces. The existing zero-second ambient-bed transition now retires an inherited score only for the two passed-only visits, then reapplies their own CG bed.

Exact two-owner audio contracts and thirty negative mutations do not broaden the global silence allowance or weaken existing validators. Cafe uses intentional silence; desk uses the existing single-source room recording. The generic recorded paper cue is not claimed as the exact crease or packet recording.
No new high-confidence defect was found within this source unit. This is not a verdict on the remaining parent833 work, PR45, current main CI completion or release.
